review.notes: Unforget is a local-only personal advice reminder app. No account, demo credentials, or internet connection is required. On the Remember tab, enter advice and tap Save advice. The app requests notification permission and schedules local reminders. In Archive, tap Test to schedule a notification within a few seconds. Swipe an entry left to delete it. No user data is transmitted externally.

en-US.title: Unforget: Advice Reminders
en-US.subtitle: Advice worth remembering
en-US.description:
Some advice is too important to lose. Unforget gives your best thoughts, realizations, encouragement, and hard-won wisdom a quiet place to return.

Write something you want to remember and Unforget will resurface it through gentle notifications. Your full message appears in the reminder, so it reaches you in the moment it can matter.

With Unforget, you can:

• Save advice, realizations, and messages to your future self
• Receive a different reminder each day
• Test a reminder whenever you want
• Browse your personal archive
• Remove anything you no longer need

Unforget is private by design. There is no account, no advertising, and no tracking. Your advice stays on your device.

Remember the advice that changes how you live.
en-US.promoText: Keep the advice, realizations, and encouragement you never want to lose.
